title: BOK Financial (BOKF) Earnings Expected to Grow: What to Know Ahead of Next Week's Release
author: Zacks.Com
description: BOK Financial is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings of $2.54 per share, representing 14.4% year-over-year growth, with revenues projected at $570.43 million (up 4%). The company has a positive Earnings ESP of +0.59% with a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), suggesting it will likely beat consensus estimates. BOK Financial has beaten EPS estimates in all four of the last quarters.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Positive Earnings ESP of +0.59% combined with Zacks Rank #3 indicates likely earnings beat. Company has beaten consensus EPS estimates in all four recent quarters. Expected 14.4% YoY earnings growth and 4% revenue growth demonstrate solid financial performance.

Negative Earnings ESP of -2.42% makes it difficult to predict an earnings beat, despite Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) and strong 25.5% YoY EPS growth expectations. Company has only beaten consensus estimates in 2 of the last 4 quarters, showing inconsistent performance.

title: CalPrivate Bank Appoints Angel Martinez to the CalPrivate Bank Board
author: Rick Sowers
description: CalPrivate Bank announced the appointment of Angel Martinez, former CEO of Deckers Brands, to its Board of Directors. Martinez brings over 45 years of experience in the footwear industry and is expected to contribute strategic insights to the bank's growth and client service.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Expanding board with an experienced executive, highlighting growth and strategic vision
